title: The Children's Museum of Green Bay

services.name: Vet Clinic
services.desc: The Animal House Vet Clinic, in Our Town, is an exciting place to take care of the pets. Children will groom and take care of sick pets using doctor and grooming tools. Children can play the role of the veterinarian while looking at real X-rays or looking at samples under a microscope. In the event of inclement weather, The Children's Museum follows The Green Bay School District's school closure schedule. services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Join us as we introduce robotics, programming, and coding. We will step into the world of STEM to explore robots and coding through games and experiments! We are oozing with fun! Come mix, mash, and blend unexpected ingredients to create a collection of crazy concoctions. Slime and oobleck and messes, oh my! Blast off into a stellar summer as we travel light years out of this world and into outer space! We’ll learn about planets, the solar system, galaxies, and stars through cosmic crafts and hands-on science.
